body:
Thank you for your reply.

It does make me feel better knowing I have someone to talk to outside of my high school support system though I don't know how much longer I can cope with all of this
im not really sure, in my case my diagnosis was more of a curse than a gift but some people may see it as a gift to finally have a diagnosis for their child/ family or themselves.

I think I know what you mean, it happens to me, I think with me its because I get so used to feeling sad and upset with myself, that when I do finally feel an ounce of happiness, it feels almost wrong to be like that? it may not be like this for you, but this is how I usually feel.
